# Week 11 build notes: Capstone, week 2 (Northgate fieldwork)

Built 2026-11-23 on branch `course-v2`. Not committed. Week plan in `docs/build/week11.js`.

## Files
- `course-w11-lessons.js`: Talk 11.1 (Evidence from three sources), Talk 11.2 (When words and evidence disagree), `COURSE_QUIZ.w11` (20 questions, correct answers spread 5/5/5/5).
- `course-w11-labs.js`: Lab 11.1 Core evidence check (EV-01 to EV-11, 12 checkpoints, 10 auto-checked), Lab 11.2 Scan check (SCAN-01 to SCAN-03, 12 checkpoints, 10 auto-checked).
- `course-w11-practice.js`: `levels-w11` (14 practice-client cases -> response level), `acro-w11` (20 acronyms).
- `course-w11-figures.js`: `w11-three-sources`, `w11-evidence-wins`. Generated by a scratch script (helpers and palette copied from `docs/tools/make_week1_figures.js`); not saved under `docs/tools` because this build was limited to the files listed here. Ask if you want it added as `docs/tools/make_week11_figures.js`.
- `course-w11-mock.js`: `window.MOCK_W11` (brief, parts, key of evidence facts and lab answers, 5 rubricNotes). No model scores: the instructor model pack stays outside the repo.

## Decisions
- Interviews: INT-01 (Linda Harper) happens in Week 10 Day 2; Week 11 has the other four. Interview blocks deep-link to `interview.html?p=INT-0X`.
- Evidence: everyone reviews the core set EV-01 to EV-11 (as the legacy lab did). EV-12 to EV-21 may be used only if an interview gave the ID ("earned evidence"), which keeps the simulator's reward for good questions.
- Scoring is split: Govern and Identify (Q1-Q17) in Week 11, Protect to Recover in Week 12. The fieldwork package is due end of Week 11 with Q1-Q17 scored; the full workbook is graded in Week 12.
- Talks teach the method with practice-client examples so they do not give away Northgate scores. The only Northgate contradiction named in the talks or quiz is the MFA claim vs the MFA report, which the legacy lesson and quiz already used.

## Legacy absorbed
- Legacy week 9 Lesson 3 (evidence: documents, interviews, scans, contradictions, corroboration, Nmap, Nessus, CVSS) -> Talks 11.1 and 11.2. Lesson 4's first paragraph (score each question: level + IDs + why; gaps) -> Talk 11.2. Interview-planning half of Lesson 3 is in Week 10.
- Legacy week 9 quiz: three evidence sources, evidence ID example, MFA contradiction, Nmap, Nessus, CVSS 9.8, who runs the scans, no-evidence scoring -> rewritten into `COURSE_QUIZ.w11` (8 items) plus 12 new scenario questions.
- Legacy week 9 labs 4, 5, 7 (evidence review, scan review, contradictions) -> blocks b3/b4 (Day 1), b2-b5 (Day 2). Lab 6 (score all 41) -> split across Weeks 11-12. Deliverable (fieldwork package) -> Day 2 b8, same submission path.
- labInfo materials: every file is linked from a block or the `anytime` list (fieldwork worksheets).
- Dropped: nothing. Legacy week 9 quiz items on zero trust, CSF, weights, levels, and open questions belong to Week 10; weighted compliance, CMM, and hygiene items belong to Week 12.

## New facts
- No new Northgate facts. Lab answers come from the existing files (see `MOCK_W11.key.labAnswers`).
- Practice-client examples (unnamed, clearly not Northgate) in Talk 11.2, the quiz, the figure, and `levels-w11`: a visitor-book contradiction (the worksheet's own example format), a training export with 31 of 40 completed, and 14 calibration cases.
- New external URLs in `anytime`: https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-basics.html and https://www.first.org/cvss/v3.1/specification-document (well known, not fetched during this build).

## Shared-file changes needed
1. `MCCoE_Student_Platform.html` `submitWeek()`: for weeks 9-10 it blocks submission until the legacy quiz is taken and a reflection is written. The Week 11 quiz now lives at `Quiz.html?w=11`. Please skip the quiz check for weeks 9-10 (or accept the course quiz). Until then the block text tells students to take that page's quiz if the button asks.
2. Tracker: a grading view for `w11` that shows the Week 9 `deliverableLink` (mccoe_progress), the interview panel (mccoe_interviews), and Lab 11.1/11.2 answers (mccoe_course), with `MOCK_W11.rubricNotes`.
3. `interview.html`: text says "Plan your questions first (Week 9 lab, step 2)" and "The interviews open with Week 9". Change to Week 10 (Lab 10.6) / Week 11.
4. `materials/week9/*` pages say "Week 9", "Week 10", and "12-Week Program"; the evidence index says to open items only when an interview gives the ID. Update the wording to match the 15-week course and the core-set rule.
5. `docs/tools/estimate_time.js` checks `p.mode === 'flash'`, but practice data uses `kind: 'flash'`, so flash sets are estimated at the sort rate. Not used in Week 11's day totals (the acronym set is in `anytime`).
6. `course-data.js`: replace the Week 11 stub (`legacy: 9`) with this staging entry when approved.
